components.name: Arithmetic-demand and sparse-generator bracket for witness precision
components.project_addition: Normalize the arithmetic Wronskian coefficient budget by complementary multiplicity residuals to obtain target-specific integer capacities K; derive the triple-only demand floor lambda_abc<=mu; construct explicit two-prime-coordinate non-degenerate witnesses from nonzero additive/degeneracy row minors to obtain mu<=U2; and transport earlier high-quality residual pressure to a witness-precision floor. Integer kernel/minor algebra and Pasten's witness lattice are prior art or elementary; the finite certificate-sandwich integration is novelty-unverified.
